data.name: Jagpreet
data.gender_notes: Jagpreet is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jagpreet is derived from two Sanskrit words: Jagat meaning 'world' and Preet meaning 'love'. The name signifies the love and grace of the Lord for the entire world. The name Jagpreet carries the meaning “Lord's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Hindi. Parents who choose Jagpreet usually hope their child will grow to embody lord's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jagpreet is a name that signifies the love and grace of God for the entire world. It is a reminder of the divine presence that surrounds us and the love that God has for each one of us.
data.etymology: Jagpreet belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagpreet total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
